clock.reference: Original DOS6 bios/msinit.asm:219-662 clock conversion/date/time/BCD routines.
clock.decision: Retain substantive RTC service unit at DOS7 resident placement. Remove only DOS7_CONFIG conditional wrappers and unselected alternatives, retaining selected DOS7 implementation and all original unrelated POWER/ROMDOS conditionals.

clock.header: Microsoft copyright and original revision/procedure comments preserved; BYTE_SYSINIT moved below header; TITLE corrected to initclk; result comment corrected to daycnt2.

instdata.decision: Merge entire data sequence into preceding ststate; preserve initialized and uninitialized values, types, original comments, public interfaces and byte alignment. Add EXE include dependency to makefile.
